title: Control Plane: Server Error Surge
description: Elevated rate of 5xx responses across control-plane endpoints — availability/reliability signal that should correlate with the REL-2 watchdog and task-failure metrics.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Control Plane Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Control Plane Access Logs') and ('Status Code' >= 500) | stats count as errors by 'URI Path' | where errors > 20
falsepositives: A known downstream OCI outage causing transient 5xx
